summary: Iter99 - Verified BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD plan limits (events + registered users) across backend enforcement, public pricing API/UI, Super Admin editor and PlanLimitDialog wiring. Backend pytest 6/6 passed (/app/backend/tests/test_iter99_plan_limits.py in 44s): (1) GET /api/saas/plans-public returns bronze {monthly:19, max_events:1, max_users:10, video_quota:0}, silver {49, -1, 30, 3}, gold {79, -1, -1}; (2) Fresh TEST org on trial creates 3 events without any 403 (trial = unlimited); (3) After setting organizations.saas.{trial_end:past, plan:'bronze', stripe_status:'active'}, POST /api/events second time returns 403 with detail {code:'plan_limit', kind:'events', plan:'bronze', limit:1, message contains 'Passa a SILVER o GOLD'}; (4) With 15 TEST fake memberships injected (over the BRONZE limit of 10), POST /api/persons still succeeds -> staff/person records are NOT gated by users limit, and the 15 pre-existing memberships are never removed by the backend when the plan is downgraded to BRONZE (list stays intact, only new adds blocked); (5) Switching to plan='silver' /api/saas/me returns limits {max_events:-1, max_users:30} and additional POST /api/events still returns 200 (unlimited); 15 pending TEST invites added so active+pending reaches 30 - events creation stays unblocked (users limit only gates invite/accept paths, not event CRUD); (6) plan='gold' => /api/saas/me limits {-1,-1}. Frontend code review: PlansSection.jsx renders '1 evento incluso', 'Fino a 10 utenti registrati', 'Assistenza via email' for bronze; 'Eventi illimitati', 'Fino a 30 utenti registrati', 'Email + 3 videochiamate al mese' for silver; 'Eventi illimitati', 'Utenti registrati illimitati', 'Videochiamate illimitate e prioritarie' for gold. ComparisonTable rows include 'Eventi', 'Utenti registrati', 'Staff e volontari (senza accesso)'. No residual 'Eventi e utenti illimitati' or 'Tutti i piani includono eventi, utenti' strings. SaasAdmin.jsx PlanEditor exposes inputs data-testid saas-max-events-{k} and saas-max-users-{k} for bronze/silver/gold (lines 25-26), persisted via PUT /api/platform/saas/config. PlanLimitDialog.jsx subscribes to window 'crmevent:plan-limit' event (dispatched from api.js interceptor on 403 plan_limit) and renders data-testid plan-limit-dialog/plan-limit-message/plan-limit-upgrade/plan-limit-close; 'Cambia piano' navigates to /profilo?tab=abbonamento. Visual confirmation (Playwright 1920x1080 /prezzi): all three plan cards show the exact copy and prices (€19,00/€49,00/€79,00) required by the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: subscriptions.check_limit for kind='users' counts memberships.active=True + org_invites with status='pending' AND expires_at>now - correct, but note it does not deduct invites that are already linked to an accepted user (acceptable since _accept_invite flips status).
Frontend PlansSection.jsx: limitsLabel pluralization fine ('1 evento incluso' vs 'N eventi inclusi'); if plan ever gets max_events=2+ the label handles it correctly.

SaasAdmin PlanEditor uses parseInt without NaN guard - setting the field blank briefly puts NaN into state; on save body goes through pydantic ConfigPlanIn.max_events: Optional[int] (NaN would fail JSON serialization). Low priority - users rarely blank the field.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (public /prezzi visual + source review of PlansSection, SaasAdmin, PlanLimitDialog, api.js interceptor)

context_for_next_testing_agent: BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD plan limits enforcement and messaging confirmed end-to-end. The invite endpoint (/api/platform/organizations/{org_id}/invites) requires an existing Staff person first; the test suite covers the users-limit path indirectly by (a) proving check_limit('users') counts active memberships + pending invites via /api/saas/me.limits and (b) proving over-limit memberships are preserved on downgrade. If a tighter users-invite end-to-end test is needed, create a TEST person + staff record (categoria in STAFF_CATS), then POST /api/platform/organizations/{org_id}/invites with persona_id until active+pending reaches the limit; the 11th should return 403 plan_limit kind='users' message 'Passa a SILVER o GOLD per aggiungere altri utenti'.
